metadata.title: Southeast Asia Oil Palm Multi-Model Conviction & Consensus Intelligence

territories.name: Perlis
territories.conviction_method: v2: 60% worst-pair model agreement + 40% EC ENS relative spread
territories.diagnosis: Operational Day 1–5 drier bias: EC Hybrid (8.5 mm/day) sits below the 14-day ensemble consensus (9.4 mm/day). Wide ensemble dispersion (P20–P80: 4.0–13.4 mm/day; spread 9.4 mm/day) reflects high convective uncertainty. Overwhelming Tri-Model Consensus: European ECMWF (9.4 mm/day), American NOAA GEFS (9.6 mm/day), and Google DeepMind WeatherNext AI (9.0 mm/day) converge on the same precipitation regime (spread < 1.0 mm/day), establishing highest-tier operational conviction. Moderate Harvesting Impact: Wet estate conditions (8.5 mm/day) with periodic afternoon downpours; minor delays in FFB transport, though soil moisture replenishment remains favorable.
